gloss: that day, the day in question

definitions.gloss: that day, the day in question, the appointed day
definitions.explanation: The specific day being discussed or the day when an event takes place.

examples.japanese: {当日|とうじつ}は{晴|は}れるでしょう。
examples.english: It will probably be sunny on that day.

examples.japanese: {当日|とうじつ}{券|けん}を{購入|こうにゅう}する。
examples.english: I will purchase a same-day ticket.

examples.japanese: {当日|とうじつ}キャンセルは{料金|りょうきん}がかかる。

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{当|とう} (this, the relevant) + {日|じつ} (day)

USAGE:
Refers to the specific day being discussed or the day of an event. Can mean "that day" (referring to a past event) or "on the day" (same-day, as opposed to in advance).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {当日|とうじつ}{券|けん}: same-day ticket
- {当日|とうじつ}{予約|よやく}: same-day reservation
- {当日|とうじつ}キャンセル: same-day cancellation
- イベント{当日|とうじつ}: the day of the event
- {当日|とうじつ}{受付|うけつけ}: on-site registration

DAY SEQUENCE:
- {前日|ぜんじつ}: the day before
- {当日|とうじつ}: that day, the day of
- {翌日|よくじつ}: the next day, the following day
